items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I know that one time we were all by to see Shorty Baker, he was at the Alvin Hotel and we all stopped by to see him

ctx.x: Did you see Hawk very often during the last years....

No I didn't. I didn't see Hawk all the time that he was growing a beard. I didn't see the Hawk. I know that one time we were all by to see Shorty Baker, he was at the Alvin Hotel and we all stopped by to see him, he wasn't feeling too well.
